title: cpt: a differentiable constraint projection layer for autoregressive models
description: Code, artifacts and verification for "Steering Crystal Generation at Every Token: A Differentiable Constraint Projection for Autoregressive Models". Solves a convex constrained projection of the next-token distribution at every decoding step and trains through it, so one trained network serves a family of numerical property targets it never trained for.
